note: Every site needs a source link. A site without one is left out. Positions are from OpenStreetMap's search and are approximate: see SOURCES.md before relying on them for the photo distance check.

sites.name: Lingampally railway underpasses
sites.source_note: South First, 23 Sep 2023: the two underpasses at Lingampally Railway Station flood in short downpours; GHMC barricades the road when they do.
sites.position: Lingampally Railway Station (OpenStreetMap). Close to the underpasses.

sites.name: Raheja Mindspace entrance underpass
sites.source_note: The News Minute, 24 Jun 2019, from a Cyberabad Traffic Police advisory: underpass near the Raheja Mindspace campus entrance, between Cyber Gateway and Mindspace.
sites.position: A building inside Mindspace (OpenStreetMap). Approximate: the underpass is on the campus road.

sites.name: Near Shilparamam, Madhapur
sites.source_note: The News Minute, 24 Jun 2019, from a Cyberabad Traffic Police advisory: near Shilparamam, on the road between Hitex Charminar and the Cyber Towers junction.
sites.position: Shilparamam park centre (OpenStreetMap). Approximate: the flooding is on the road beside it.

sites.name: Nectar Gardens, Madhapur
sites.source_note: The News Minute, 24 Jun 2019, from a Cyberabad Traffic Police advisory: Nectar Gardens, on the road linking Madhapur to Road No. 45.

sites.name: Cyber Towers junction
sites.source_note: The News Minute, 24 Jun 2019, from a Cyberabad Traffic Police advisory: the road between the Cyber Towers junction and the Kavuri Hills junction, in both directions.

sites.name: Lakdikapul railway bridge
sites.source_note: Deccan Chronicle, 19 Oct 2024: officials inspected Lakdikapul, where the drain under the railway bridge is to be renovated to stop waterlogging.
sites.position: Lakdikapul Road (OpenStreetMap). Approximate, within a few hundred metres of the bridge.
